title: Senior Backend Platform Engineer - Profiling Services
description_html: NVIDIA's Developer Tools team is seeking a Senior Backend Platform Engineer to build scalable and reliable capabilities for profiling services. This role combines production backend engineering with data-intensive systems work. You will improve how complex performance data is processed, served, and operated. The work involves close collaboration with partners in frontend, security, product, and source systems.     What you’ll be doing:     Design and build production backend services for interactive performance analysis and collaborative workflows.    Improve the responsiveness, scalability, and efficiency of data-intensive product experiences.    Develop reliable capabilities for onboarding, validating, organizing, and serving large performance datasets.    Create durable service interfaces and data models that can evolve as product needs grow.    Engineer resilient behavior for concurrency, partial failures, retries, and recovery.    Establish effective testing, observability, and operational practices for the capabilities you own.    Partner with frontend, security, product, and source-system teams to deliver complete customer workflows.       What we need to see:     BS or MS in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.    5+ years of experience building production backend services, distributed systems, analytical systems, or data platforms using Python or a comparable language.    Strong software engineering fundamentals, including automated tests, failure handling, production diagnostics, and compatible evolution of APIs or stored data.    For service-focused work, experience with asynchronous backends and hands-on depth in query execution or real-time stateful systems.    For data-focused work, strong SQL and experience with ingestion, schema evolution, analytical storage, or query-optimized data modeling.    Sound judgment about failure and concurrency, demonstrated through problems such as cancellation, replay, safe retries, or recovery.    Ability to measure system behavior and turn logs, metrics, traces, load tests, or data-quality signals into practical improvements.    A record of working across client, service, data, and security concerns to ship a complete production workflow.       Ways to stand out from the crowd:     Practical coding skills in Python, C++, or Rust, encompassing the capability to write, review, and direct production-quality infrastructure software. Experience with Rust is highly valued.    Experience making high-cardinality, time-indexed, trace, telemetry, or profiling workloads responsive at scale.    Experience keeping live state consistent with WebSockets, pub/sub, replay, or comparable real-time techniques.    Experience improving analytical reads or ingestion with columnar formats, embedded query engines, analytical stores, progressive detail, or incremental processing.    Background in generated clients, secure sharing, authorization-aware caching, provenance, lifecycle automation, or cost attribution.       Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 140,000 USD - 224,250 USD.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 1, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.   NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Identity and Security - Profiling Services
description_html: NVIDIA's Developer Tools team is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to strengthen identity, security, and reliability for profiling services. Performance data can contain sensitive technical and operational information that requires thoughtful protection. This role turns security requirements into practical controls and dependable operating practices. You will partner across engineering and security teams to deliver solutions that users and operators can trust.     What you’ll be doing:      Design and build identity, authorization, and service-trust capabilities for a collaborative cloud application.      Translate security and access requirements into controls that are practical for users and product teams.      Strengthen credential handling, auditing, isolation, and protection of sensitive performance data.      Build secure, reproducible infrastructure and delivery practices for supported environments.      Improve release safety, recovery, and operational resilience for services and persistent data.      Establish useful security and reliability signals for incident response, resource management, and ongoing improvement.      Partner with engineering and security teams to identify risks, validate controls, and address failures before release.       What we need to see:      BS or MS in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience.      5+ years of experience building and operating production identity, security, platform, infrastructure, or reliability systems.      Candidates should have deep expertise in identity and authorization systems or secure platform engineering and production reliability. Ability in adjacent fields is encouraged, but expertise in all areas is not required.      Practical experience implementing trusted sign-in, browser and service credentials, and resource authorization using standards such as OAuth 2.0 or OpenID Connect.      Working knowledge of securely configuring, deploying, and operating containerized services through automation.      Strong software engineering ability in at least one service or automation language, including maintainable code, tests, and production diagnostics.      Sound threat-modeling and distributed-systems judgment demonstrated through service trust, isolation, partial failure, credential handling, or abuse-resistance decisions.      A record of defining a bounded MVP under ambiguity, collaborating across organizational boundaries, and turning architecture into an operated production capability.       Ways to stand out from the crowd:      Experience implementing workload identity, token exchange, delegated access, mutual TLS, policy-based authorization, or authorization-aware caching.      Experience securing or operating real-time connections and shared state across multiple service instances.      Hands-on work building telemetry and operating containerized services with cloud-native tooling.      Experience implementing audit, retention, export, deletion, privacy, or compliance controls for sensitive technical data.     Practical coding skills in Python, C++, or Rust, encompassing the capability to write, review, and direct production-quality infrastructure software. Experience with Rust is highly valued.       Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 1, 2026.
